draft.subject: Photographing Harbour Winds' Spring Program at The Example Room
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to your April 2 Spring Program at The Example Room. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the playing isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, with work at Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall as well, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
